units.source_text: 他坐起身，手脚像水枕似的沉沉地耷拉着。

en.t: He sat up, his arms and legs hanging heavily like water pillows.

units.source_text: 他把丢在泥地间里的空水壶捧起来，把壶口倾斜地对准自己的嘴。

en.t: He picked up the empty water bottle that had been thrown onto the muddy ground and tilted its mouth toward his own.

units.source_text: 足足花了三十多秒，好容易掉下了两三滴，稍稍沾湿了舌尖。

en.t: After more than thirty full seconds, two or three drops finally fell, just barely moistening the tip of his tongue.

units.source_text: 但是，立刻就像碰到吸水纸似的干涸了，

en.t: But they dried up at once, as if they had touched blotting paper,

units.source_text: 等了半天的喉咙，更加疯狂地折腾起来。

en.t: and his throat, after waiting so long, began to writhe even more frantically.
